Where to get every drop

Most crafting bottlenecks are Pal drops rather than ore nodes. Each page lists every Pal that drops the item, the quantity range and the exact drop chance, so you can pick the fastest farm instead of guessing. Prioritise the 100% sources first — those hand you a fixed amount on every kill.
